evidence.protocol: TCP: HB got no reply; the kernel retransmitted 1 times (RTO 0.223 → 5.79 s); no RST, so the connection survived; the first HB_ACK came after 3.03 s of silence.
evidence.label: In-home queueing (likely)
evidence.next_step: The delay starts before the router: check the Wi-Fi signal and heavy traffic from other devices at home
evidence.protocol_ko: TCP: HB에 응답이 없었어요. 커널이 1번 재전송했어요(RTO 0.223 → 5.79초). RST가 없어 연결은 살아 있었어요. 3.03초 동안 조용하다가 첫 HB_ACK이 왔어요.
